summary: P3 SecuritySpec v2 mining/review implements a finite 13-operation DSL with strict per-predicate parameter validation, content-addressed atomic CAS and verified dependencies, a finite state machine restricting LLM-origin specs to non-active states, and a shadow compiler that accepts only qualification-backed stable specs with resolved evidence/dependencies and no conflict. Model output selects only system-provided proposal IDs and cannot invent security facts or authority. Runtime remains shadow with active_product_effect=none, adds only identity metadata to the existing Decision Trace terminal event, and has no dependency on Candidate, validation or reporting authority packages. Web review/apply-import fails closed without reviewer identity, and import dry-run never persists. The answer-free qualification corpus meets all thresholds with zero safe false activation. No path was found that activates an unqualified/stale/conflicting spec, forges trusted review or qualification, affects Candidate/Proof/terminal authority, or permits anonymous writes.

non_blocking_findings.title: Qualification registry/compiler freshness is enforced only in the builtin loader, not inside shadow runtime run()
non_blocking_findings.evidence: qualification.py verifies registry_sha256/compiler_sha256 against the running registry/compiler, while shadow.py run() and models.py validate_qualification only require well-formed hashes. The only current injected qualification is the freshness-verified builtin value and the result is shadow-only.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Before P5 authority, centralize freshness checks in run() or put_qualification so future non-builtin qualifications cannot authorize predicates against stale registry/compiler semantics.

non_blocking_findings.title: kind/predicate equality and per-predicate parameter shapes rely on Python validators rather than the packaged JSON schema alone
non_blocking_findings.evidence: models.py and registry.py enforce kind==predicate and exact parameter keys, while security-spec-v2.schema.json represents parameters generically. All runtime import and archive paths use the Python validators, so no current reachable weakening exists.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Document the Python validators as authoritative and consider schema oneOf/const tightening before external schema-only consumption.

non_blocking_findings.title: Web detail compile preview trusts the spec's own evidence/dependency lists
non_blocking_findings.evidence: zscope/web/services.py compiles a detail preview using the viewed spec's evidence_refs and dependency_hashes. It is read-only but does not resolve the preview against live code facts.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Label this display as non-authoritative and resolve against actual scan facts before P5 authority.

non_blocking_findings.title: Design and packaged schema copies have distinct byte hashes
non_blocking_findings.evidence: design-manifest binds docs/design schema copies while the qualification manifest binds packaged copies; the reviewed differences are semantically compatible formatting/reference forms.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Make the copies byte-identical or record and automatically validate an explicit canonical source-of-truth rule.

non_blocking_findings.title: Unused review-write helper and counting-fake cache metric scope
non_blocking_findings.evidence: lifecycle.py defines reject_review_write while Web paths use SecuritySpecReviewService.write_rejected_payload directly; the qualification cache reduction is measured with a counting fake client.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Remove or route through the helper, and keep the 1.0 reduction claim scoped to deterministic cache behavior until P5/P6 external-model measurement.

checks.name: security_spec_v2_identity_and_content_binding
checks.evidence: models.py validates exact keys, seal, UID/revision, kind/predicate, subject/slot/scope/parameters, unique evidence refs, dependency hashes, origin/status and exclusive authority ref; store.py resolves all CAS dependencies fail-closed.

checks.name: finite_thirteen_operation_dsl_no_smuggling
checks.evidence: registry.py defines exactly 13 predicates, exact parameter keys, strict slot syntax and finite enums; arbitrary parameters and query-like data are rejected.

checks.name: llm_proposal_selection_only
checks.evidence: models.py prevents active LLM-origin status; miner.py validates system-provided proposal catalog entries and rejects invented or duplicate IDs and unprovided evidence.

checks.name: qualification_backed_stable_shadow_only_activation
checks.evidence: compiler.py requires stable status, a resolved qualification ref, resolved evidence/dependencies and no active conflict; shadow.py can promote only exact non-LLM mined specs and always reports no active product effect.

checks.name: cas_atomicity_and_review_hash_chain
checks.evidence: store.py uses mkstemp, fsync and atomic replace with collision/cycle checks, contiguous revisions and bound review chains; archive.py rejects duplicate keys, chain branching, cycles and disconnected events.

checks.name: no_security_spec_authority_flow_before_p5
checks.evidence: Package and lifecycle gates forbid Candidate/validation/reporting authority imports and live edges; orchestration and alert verification attach only validated shadow identity metadata and do not emit a terminal event.

checks.name: qualification_corpus_answer_free_and_reproducible
checks.evidence: The corpus manifest separates source from expected contracts, declares no product expected-data read, network or external model use, and qualification code computes all metrics from 143 neutral cases with a counting fake client.

checks.name: web_api_write_fail_closed
checks.evidence: web/server.py returns 403 reviewer_identity_unavailable for review and apply-import; services.py dry-run returns applied=false and contains no persistence call.

checks.name: finite_state_machine_and_authority_exclusivity
checks.evidence: models.py fixes allowed transitions, rejects dual qualification/review authority refs and requires exactly one authority ref for project_active/stable; rejected/quarantined states cannot reactivate.

checks.name: archive_import_all_or_nothing
checks.evidence: archive.py validates keys, bundle hash, store revision, identities and review chain before returning a preview; JSON duplicate keys and XLSX sheet/order/header/content hash mismatches are rejected.

limitations: The review was read-only; no files were modified and no benchmark was executed.
No external-model benchmark was run; model behavior was assessed statically and from counting-fake qualification evidence.
Range truth, fixture answers, and benchmark scorer inputs were not read.

Full test evidence of 1941 passed and 7 skipped, qualification scripts and wheel package gates was trusted from recorded manifests; source was inspected but the full suite was not independently rerun.
The three historical P0 benchmark aggregates remain absent and were not replayed.
